notes: Gathered on 2026-11-18 with WebFetch (page text summarised by a small model; dates and amounts were requested as exact sentences and copied as stated) and WebSearch used only to find URLs. Every entry's source_url is a page that was fetched and read. Facts seen only in search snippets are in gaps. Rolling or undated programmes are not entries because an entry needs a closing date. No websummit.com, lu.ma, luma.com, meetup.com or eventbrite pages were fetched. Several refusals are in gaps. entries.name: INPI and EUIPO SME Fund 2026 (IP vouchers)
entries.what: Vouchers that reimburse part of the fees for protecting intellectual property, open to EU-based SMEs and applied for through the EUIPO. The INPI page states the application period as "De 2 de fevereiro a 4 de dezembro de 2026". Reimbursement is 90% of IP Scan costs (voucher 1), 75% of trademark and design fees (voucher 2), 75% of national and European patent fees (voucher 3), 75% of EU plant variety fees (voucher 4) and 50% of geographical indication costs (voucher 5).
entries.amount: Caps per voucher: EUR 1,260 (IP Scan in Portugal), EUR 700 (trademarks and designs), EUR 1,000 per patent, EUR 1,500 (plant varieties), EUR 2,000 (geographical indications), as stated by INPI

entries.name: InovIA Vouchers para Inovacao (FCT computing vouchers)
entries.what: Computing vouchers for companies, published on the FCT website with the contact given as Serviços de Computação Avançada. The page states "Prazo das candidaturas: até 31 de dezembro de 2026". Startups and SMEs based in Portugal are eligible, with at least 50% of the vouchers reserved for them; applications are first come, first served. Each initial voucher is 50,000 CPU core-hours, 1,000 GPU-hours and 1 TB of storage for 6 months, and resources can be increased after evaluation.
entries.amount: Not a cash amount: 50,000 CPU core-hours, 1,000 GPU-hours and 1 TB storage per initial voucher
entries.organiser: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT)
entries.organiser_note: organiser read from the source page on 2026-11-19 by startups.b.research@PrompTugal.dinis, checked by startups.b@

entries.name: Global Health Accelerator 2026-2027 (Startup Braga)
entries.what: Accelerator run by Startup Braga for early or intermediate stage startups with a minimum viable product in human health, biotechnology and nanotechnology (medical devices, digital health, diagnostics and similar). The article states "As candidaturas decorrem até 23 de novembro de 2026, às 23:59" and that the programme runs from 15 December 2026 to 6 May 2027, ending with a Demo Day. Participation is free and takes no equity. This is a news report of the call; the official application page is startupbrag.acceleratorapp.co.
entries.amount: Free to join, no equity taken (no cash amount stated)
entries.organiser_note: organiser read from the source page on 2026-11-19 by startups.b.research@PrompTugal.dinis, checked by startups.b@

entries.name: ARRISCA C 2026 (University of Coimbra business idea competition)
entries.what: 15th edition of the national science and technology based business idea competition run by the University of Coimbra. Open to teachers, researchers, technical staff, grant holders and current or former students of any Portuguese higher education institution, individually or in teams of up to five; a junior category is open to secondary and vocational students. The report (published 26 October 2026) states the deadline as 23:59 on 18 December. Partner services such as incubation and mentoring are awarded on top of the cash prizes.
entries.amount: First prize EUR 2,500, second EUR 1,250, third EUR 500 in four categories; junior category EUR 750, EUR 500, EUR 250
entries.organiser_note: organiser read from the source page on 2026-11-19 by startups.b.research@PrompTugal.dinis, checked by startups.b@
